pages.title: Brewing Station
pages.text: The Alchemy Pot is the heart of Gensokyo's brewing. It has 12 item slots and a 1000 mB fluid tank, and can handle alchemy, witch hexbrew recipes, and other potion-stage recipes.

$(bold)Using the pot$()$(br)Right-click with a fluid container to fill or drain the tank. Right-click with an item to add it to the brew; buckets and similar containers are handled automatically. Right-click with an empty hand to take back the last item, or sneak-right-click to empty the pot.$(br2)The pot shows hints for ingredients accepted by the current recipe. For the complete recipe list, look under Alchemy Pot in JEI.
